description: Actual built renderer screenshots displayed in full at native size, with annotations outside the application images.
sourceVerification: The nine original English strings occur in both the captured baseline and the accepted baseline; their replacements occur in the captured candidate. Accessible and search copies were verified in source.
syntheticFixtures: Seeded workspace and fake engines with isolated loopback ports.
Frames 07–08 additionally install a synthetic openLending function to expose the actual conditional desktop-bridge button; the function is not invoked.
limitation: These images and measurements cover the browser renderer; installed Electron results are reported separately.

changes.source: Ligado, um prompt novo para ${name} espera a resposta em curso terminar, em qualquer conversa. Desligado, segue Configurações › Agentes › Respostas.
changes.before: On, a new prompt for ${name} waits for the running reply to end, in any conversation. Off, it follows Settings › Agents › Replies.
changes.after: New prompts for ${name} wait until its current reply finishes, across all conversations. When off, Settings › Agents › Replies applies.
changes.reason: Replace the awkward On/Off construction; preserve the agent name, all-conversation scope and fallback setting.

changes.source: Cada prompt ganha uma resposta própria, ao lado das que já estão em curso. Passando deste número, o prompt espera na fila até uma terminar. Um agente pode ir uma por vez na página dele.
changes.before: Each prompt gets its own reply beside the running ones. Past this number, it waits in the queue until one ends. An agent can go one at a time on its own page.
changes.after: New prompts start separate replies up to this limit, then queue until one finishes. An agent can override this with “One reply at a time”.
changes.reason: Name the limit and the exact per-agent override instead of vague page narration.
